notes:
This is a minor release because it adds a new in-app audit workflow.

FEATURES

- Added **Audit exports** to the More menu. Choose an originals folder and an export folder to run the same local checks as `markseal.audit_exports` without a terminal.
- The audit shows per-file issues, logged box counts, wide-box warnings, masked percentages, and optional OCR candidates. It supports progress, cancellation, and a JSON report.
- Added optional OCR verification and saved blocked-pattern checks. Both stay local and are off unless selected.

ENHANCEMENTS

- Audit results remain available while the panel is open and can be saved as a JSON report.

FIXES

- Malformed coordinate logs now produce an audit issue instead of an unhandled exception.
- Verify now explains when coordinate logs are disabled and tells you to enable and save before verifying, instead of reporting a missing file.

OPTIMIZATIONS

- None.

The Windows installer is unsigned; Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning. Linux and macOS builds are produced in CI without running the test suite on those platforms.
